effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a card with [Sukamon] in its name, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] If this Digimon has [Sukamon] or [Etemon] in its name, you may play 1 [Chuumon] from your trash suspended without paying the cost.
